definitions.explanation: Describes something that is of little importance or consequence. A somewhat formal word used to characterize matters, details, or issues as not worth serious attention.

examples.japanese: {瑣末|さまつ}なこと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気|き}にしない→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: I don't worry about trivial things.

examples.japanese: {瑣末|さまつ}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{費|つい}やす→費やす：10424_tsuiyasu⟧べきで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: You shouldn't spend time on trivial problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べれば→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧、⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{瑣末|さまつ}な⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: Compared to the success of this plan, such petty complaints are not worth mentioning.

notes:
USAGE:
A na-adjective meaning trivial or insignificant. The kanji {瑣|さ} means "small, trivial" and {末|まつ} means "end, minor." Used in relatively formal or written contexts. Sometimes written as {些末|さまつ} with a different first character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瑣末|さまつ}なこと (trivial things)
- {瑣末|さまつ}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (trivial problem)
- {瑣末|さまつ}な⟦{事柄|ことがら}→事柄：11420_kotogara⟧ (trivial matters)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{些細|ささい}→些細：07160_sasai⟧: trivial, slight — more commonly used in everyday speech
- ⟦{些事|さじ}→些事：17804_saji⟧: trivial matter — the noun form, referring to the matter itself
- ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: not worth mentioning — an expression conveying the same idea
